item.title: Roeth: How diverse teams are helping fleets tackle efficiency and sustainability challenges
item.description: Sustainability and efficiency goals in trucking require input from a wide range of skills and backgrounds.

item.title: Podcast: Autonomous spotlight on Torc Robotics driving Freightliners
item.description: Torc Robotics is partnered with the most popular Class 8 OEM in the U.S.—and it's using generative AI to develop training simulations for its driver.

item.title: The Ram ProMaster City cargo van is back
item.description: The revived Ram ProMaster City was unveiled at Work Truck Week 2026, signaling Ram's commitment to small cargo van customers. It boasts a compact footprint, substantial cargo space, and modern safety and technology options, with sales beginning in early 2027.

item.title: Diesel prices skyrocket: U.S. average jumps nearly $1 as Iran conflict continues
item.description: Fuel prices saw their largest weekly jump since 2022. National on-highway diesel prices average $4.86 and gasoline tops $3.50, as the Middle East conflict drags on.

item.title: Harbinger launches cabover work truck as hybrid and electric
item.description: Harbinger Motors launches HC Series Cab—a medium-duty, low-cab-forward vehicle available in electric and hybrid versions—at Work Truck Week.

item.title: Flatbed spot rates keep strong, hitting strongest week since 2022
item.description: The spot market’s dry van, refrigerated, and flatbed segments were all stronger than in recent years, according to FTR Transportation Intelligence and DAT Freight & Analytics. Dry van and refrigerated rates face continued week-over-week rate drops, but flatbed strength won’t quit.

item.title: 2026 FleetOwner 500: For-hire fleets with the most tractors
item.description: Landstar joins the top 10 tractor list this year, while Old Dominion moves up, replacing Prime Inc.’s previous spot.

item.title: TransWest's director of training grew the safety culture with a passion for others' success
item.description: Kim Corona transformed TransWest's safety training and CDL programs, fostering a strong safety culture. Her leadership, mentorship, and focus on individual success have driven company growth and inspired her team.

item.title: Work Truck Week highlights: AI, new vehicles, and new engine technologies
item.description: Industry players revealed a focus on reducing operational costs and improving safety with new vocational vehicles, alongside the use of smarter telematics solutions designed to streamline fleet management and boost productivity.

item.title: Wilkens: Why cybersecurity and cargo crime are no longer separate problems
item.description: Cargo crime and cybersecurity now intersect, with digital identity and compromised systems enabling coordinated physical thefts in trucking.
